text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Chiyono O claimed victory by 
pushing past her limits. Yet Mejiro Ardan 
had also nearly exceeded her own limits in 
the heat of that fierce battle.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While Mejiro Ardan realizes that her 
desire to defeat Sakura Chiyono O has 
knocked upon the gate of her limits—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Realizing that until she finished the 
race, she had forgotten her goal of 
surpassing her sister's grandeur, she 
gained a brand-new insight.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her revelation was this: putting 
everything into competing with cherished 
rivals like Sakura Chiyono O was precisely 
what made her own running shine even 
brighter.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Deeply grateful for the rivals who helped 
her reach new heights, Mejiro Ardan 
stepped forward into a brand-new realm...!
